def sanitize_directory(directory)
  # Ensure no directory traversal and restrict to alphanumeric and underscores
  directory.gsub(/\A\.\.\/|\/\.\.\z/, '').gsub(/\/+/, '/').gsub(/\.\./, '').gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\/]/, '')
end
